region: Complete Attention including Q/K/V/output and MLP weights/biases in the three target-selected layers. LayerNorm and other layers are retained. This differs from the prior MNIST V/output/MLP support, which left task-specific Q/K untouched.
selection: Use the previously frozen target-only Cars profile region9-11, whose full Attention/MLP reset lost10.546875pp on512 selection images. No new region search or future-partner-dependent release construction. Reassess exact full support replacement cost on official tests before another protection candidate.
query: Query unprotected original target native unnormalized class scores on first256 historically inspected target profile training images; no ground truth or teacher hidden features. Use a fixed student after complete public region replacement and eight-expert TA(.2), one closed-form output-projection fit. Preserve MNIST/DTD public head rows in ideal arithmetic, report SVHN cost. This is an attacker feasibility gate, not a protection or proof that every approximate-function release can be recovered.
conditional_claim: Any release confined to this support is mapped by complete public replacement to the same state. If its queried native response is identical to the original, the fixed response recovery also has identical output and cost. Utility preservation alone does not establish response identity. This single teacher control tests whether the more task-dependent support actually obstructs this attack; it is not a new defense or an all-attack bound.
reporting: 11 fresh full evaluations and4 reused original direct fusion baselines, with source/state pins and prediction replay. Four official tests of eight-expert fusion only, no EuroSAT or eight-task mean. No rank, strength, layer, coefficient or query-budget sweep. Only proceed to a separately frozen Q/K-aware candidate if the exact-support gate yields a defensible mechanism hypothesis.
